title: Ombudsman suspends DICT exec over alleged conflict in P1.5-B deal

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Wednesday said it ordered the preventive suspension of a Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) undersecretary for alleged conflict of interest in contracts worth more than P1.5 billion. In a seven-page order, the Ombudsman said it found sufficient grounds to place DICT Undersecretary for e-government David Almirol Jr. under preventive suspension for six months without pay over his alleged failure to divest from a company he founded before it won contracts from the agency. “Almirol’s continued stay in office could prejudice the investigation, particularly given his control and custody of documents […]...
